data.name: Do not bind template (manual scheduling)
data.value: Do not assign a template (manual scheduling)

data.name: Enter a keyword to search, or select a role to immediately view all employees in that role.
data.value: Enter a keyword to search, or select a role to view all employees in that role immediately.

data.name: Enter a name/account to search, or select a role to automatically paginate and list all employees in that role. Paging does not clear selected members. The member order below represents the rotation order.
data.value: Enter a name or account to search, or select a role to automatically display all employees in that role, page by page. Changing pages does not clear selected members. The order of members below represents the rotation order.

data.name: Enter in UTC; it will not be automatically converted based on team time zones. Once a shift is saved, the scheduling start point cannot be changed.
data.value: Enter in UTC; it will not be converted automatically based on team time zones. Once a shift has been saved, the scheduling start time cannot be changed.

data.name: Members can be added or removed at any time; removing a member only clears scheduled shifts that have not started, while started and historical shifts are retained. Any resulting vacant shifts must be manually staffed.
data.value: Members can be added or removed at any time; removing a member only clears scheduled shifts that have not started, while started and historical shifts are retained. Any resulting vacant shifts must be manually staffed.

data.name: Multiple teams can share the same template. Switching or modifying the template will not regenerate saved shifts.
data.value: Multiple teams can share the same template. Switching or modifying the template will not regenerate saved shifts.

data.name: On-call emails are automatically sent to the user mailboxes (To) of all On-Call Engineers (OCEs) in the currently saved shift. CC only uses team mailboxes or mailing list addresses explicitly configured here; it does not automatically CC all team members. Supports line breaks, commas, or semicolons as separators, up to 50 addresses; leave blank to omit CC. Custom push channels configured in the application will still deliver additional notifications.
data.value: E-postar om vakt blir automatisk sende til brukarpostboksane (Til) til alle vaktingeniørane (OCE-ar) i det lagra vaktskiftet. Kopi (CC) blir berre sendt til team-postboksar eller distribusjonslisteadresser som er uttrykkeleg konfigurerte her; alle teammedlemmer blir ikkje automatisk sette på kopi. Du kan skilje opptil 50 adresser med linjeskift, komma eller semikolon. La feltet stå tomt for å utelate kopi (CC). Tilpassa push-kanalar som er konfigurerte i programmet, vil framleis sende ekstra varslingar.

data.name: Search by timezone name, city, or UTC offset. Schedule anchors are stored in UTC and displayed using the team's timezone.
data.value: Search by time zone name, city or UTC offset. Schedule anchors are stored in UTC and displayed using the team's time zone.

data.value: Selected members (can be left empty, maximum 200)
